texture.prompt: Edit this earth magic texture into a compact true pixel-art Minecraft tile material. Preserve the rich brown/ochre chipped rock facets with restrained fine golden mineral seams, but remove ALL noisy painterly texture. Strong flat color regions, carefully composed crystalline rock planes, exactly a small palette of 12 flat warm earthy colors. Clean crisp chunky pixel blocks, like a very refined 64x64 pixel-art seamless tile enlarged with nearest-neighbor; no antialiasing, no dither, no gradients, no tiny random speckles, no photographic detail. Flat albedo, seamless, opaque square image, no objects, no borders, no text. The overall impression should be finely crafted amber-veined earth magic stone.
